comment.narrative: Outputs are considerably assumed as zero at the start of the intervention.
64 Ward Councillors and Ward Recorders trained.

As per the Interim Narrative Report 2020 p.1764 ward councillors have been trained in their roles and responsibilities and their inductions. We have also helped established 62 Ward Development Committee WDC and trained them on their roles and the importance of Ward Development Committee.70 Ward Recorders were also trained under the following topics1. Legal Mandate of Ward Record Book2. Content of Ward Record book3. Purpose Focus and Scope of the Ward Record Book4. Data Collection Responsibility5. Target Users6. Operations and Management of Ward Record Book7. Alignment of Government policies.Total current value 64 Ward Councillors 70 Ward Recorders 134
